name: search_subtitles
description: Find subtitles for a movie or TV episode and get file_ids to download

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Title to search for, e.g. "The Matrix". Not needed when an id, moviehash or filename is given.

arguments.name: filename
arguments.desc: Video filename, e.g. "Chicago.Fire.S14E01.1080p.WEB.h264-ETHEL.mkv". Parsed with guessit-js into title/year/season/episode; its release name ranks matching subtitles first.

arguments.name: imdb_id
arguments.desc: IMDb id (tt0133093 or 133093). With season_number/episode_number it is the show's id.

arguments.name: tmdb_id
arguments.desc: TMDB id. With season_number/episode_number it is the show's id.

arguments.name: feature_id
arguments.desc: OpenSubtitles feature id from search_features. With season_number/episode_number it is the show's id.

arguments.name: season_number
arguments.desc: season_number

arguments.name: episode_number
arguments.desc: episode_number

arguments.name: year
arguments.desc: year

arguments.name: type
arguments.desc: Restrict to movies or TV episodes

arguments.name: languages
arguments.desc: Subtitle languages in order of preference, e.g. ["en", "pt-BR"]. Omit for all languages.

arguments.name: moviehash
arguments.desc: OpenSubtitles hash of the video file (calculate_file_hash in local mode). Exact file matches are flagged moviehash_match and ranked first.

arguments.name: hearing_impaired
arguments.desc: Subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing (SDH)

arguments.name: foreign_parts_only
arguments.desc: Subtitles that only cover foreign-language dialogue

arguments.name: include_ai_translated
arguments.desc: Include AI-translated subtitles

arguments.name: include_machine_translated
arguments.desc: Include machine-translated subtitles (usually low quality)

arguments.name: trusted_only
arguments.desc: Only subtitles from trusted uploaders

arguments.name: order_by
arguments.desc: relevance = exact title/episode and release-name matches first, then popularity

arguments.name: exact_title
arguments.desc: When searching by title, first resolve it to the exact movie/show (so "The Matrix" does not return "The Matrix Revisited"). Set false for a fuzzy text search.

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: page

arguments.name: per_page
arguments.desc: per_page

name: get_subtitle_details
description: Full metadata for one subtitle from a search result: all files (multi-CD), uploader, comments, links, and related subtitles for the same title and language

arguments.name: subtitle_id
arguments.desc: subtitle_id from search_subtitles

arguments.name: feature_id
arguments.desc: feature.feature_id of the same search result

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: The subtitle's language (speeds up the lookup)

arguments.name: related_limit
arguments.desc: related_limit

name: download_subtitle
description: Download one subtitle file by file_id and return its text (or a temporary link), with optional format conversion, FPS conversion or time shift

arguments.name: file_id
arguments.desc: file_id from search_subtitles or get_subtitle_details

arguments.name: sub_format
arguments.desc: Convert to this format. Omit to keep the original (usually srt).

arguments.name: in_fps
arguments.desc: Frame rate the subtitle was timed for (use with out_fps)

arguments.name: out_fps
arguments.desc: Frame rate of your video (use with in_fps)

arguments.name: timeshift
arguments.desc: Shift all cues by this many seconds, e.g. 2.5 or -1

arguments.name: delivery
arguments.desc: content = return the subtitle text; link = return only a temporary download URL (for large files or saving to disk)

name: search_features
description: Look up movies, TV shows and episodes on OpenSubtitles (title, year, IMDb/TMDB/feature ids, seasons and episode counts, subtitle counts per language)

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Title, e.g. "Chicago Fire"

arguments.name: imdb_id
arguments.desc: imdb_id

arguments.name: tmdb_id
arguments.desc: tmdb_id

arguments.name: feature_id
arguments.desc: feature_id

arguments.name: type
arguments.desc: type

arguments.name: year
arguments.desc: year

arguments.name: include_episodes
arguments.desc: List every episode (title, feature_id, IMDb id) per season for TV shows

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: limit

name: list_languages
description: The subtitle language codes OpenSubtitles supports (e.g. en, pt-BR, zh-CN) with their names

name: guess_filename
description: Parse a movie or episode filename with guessit-js (title, year, season, episode, release group, resolution, source, codec)

arguments.name: filename
arguments.desc: e.g. "The.Matrix.1999.1080p.BluRay.x264-GROUP.mkv"

name: get_user_info
description: The logged-in OpenSubtitles user's level, VIP status, daily download allowance and downloads remaining, so you can plan downloads
